 Real Madrid W vs Paris W – Head-to-head record
 Real Madrid and Paris FC have met several times in European competition , with their most recent encounters taking place in last season’s knockout play-off round. The Spanish side won both legs of that tie, securing a 3-2 victory in Paris before completing the job with a 2-0 home win.
 Those results should give Pau Quesada’s team confidence, although Paris have previously shown they can cause problems in Madrid, including a 1-0 victory at the Estadio Alfredo Di Stéfano in December 2023.
 Real Madrid will therefore be looking to build on their recent advantage in this fixture, while Paris will hope to repeat their earlier success on Spanish soil.

 Real Madrid W - Looking to turn draws into wins
 Real Madrid are aiming to reach the Champions League knockout rounds for the third consecutive season. Let’s take a look at their current momentum and recent performances ahead of this clash, as well as the expected Real Madrid W vs. Paris W lineups.
 Recent form
 Las Blancas have drawn 1-1 with Paris Saint-Germain and Manchester City in their last two European matches, before surrendering a two-goal lead in a 2-2 draw against Bayern Munich. Athenea del Castillo and Lineth Beerensteyn scored in Germany, but Edna Imade and Momoko Tanikawa restored parity for the hosts.
 That result forms part of a five-match unbeaten run in all competitions, comprising three wins and two draws. However, Saturday’s 1-1 draw away to Athletic Bilbao was another frustrating result, leaving Real Madrid four points behind Liga F leaders Barcelona.
 Quesada’s side will be keen to return to winning ways in Europe, particularly after their successful encounters with Paris in last season’s play-offs. Beerensteyn is one of their main attacking threats, having scored eight goals in her last seven appearances for club and country.
 Real Madrid will be without midfielder Sandie Toletti, who remains sidelined with a hamstring injury that has kept her out for the past two months. There are also concerns over Lindo Caicedo, who was forced off with a physical issue during Saturday’s draw against Athletic Bilbao.

 Paris W - Unbeaten run offers encouragement
 Let’s now turn our attention to Paris W. We will analyse the team’s momentum and recent results ahead of this match.
 Recent form
 Sandrine Soubeyrand’s team have collected two points from their first three league-phase fixtures. They began with a 5-2 defeat against reigning champions Barcelona, but responded by coming from two goals down to draw 2-2 with Arsenal.
 Paris were then denied a first European win when Häcken scored a 94th-minute equaliser in a 1-1 draw. Nevertheless, they have now gone six matches without defeat in all competitions, recording three wins and three draws.
 Paris have also previously won at the Estadio Alfredo Di Stéfano, beating Real Madrid 1-0 in December 2023. However, they will need to improve on their recent European performances to take something from Tuesday’s match.
 Paris will be without forward Clara Mateo, who is suspended following her red card in the closing stages of the draw against Häcken. Anaele Le Moguedec is expected to return to midfield after starting Friday’s match against Montpellier on the bench.

 Predictions for Real Madrid W vs. Paris Saint Germain W - A Tightly Contested Draw
 Real Madrid have scored in each of their three league-phase matches, while Paris have found the net in all three of their European fixtures so far. It suggests they are both capable of scoring in today’s match.
 Real Madrid scored twice against Bayern Munich, while Paris recently put five past Montpellier. Their respective attacking records suggest that at least three goals could be scored.
 Considering the respective European records and Real Madrid’s home advantage, our primary prediction is Real Madrid W to win .
